# Basketball Custom BPM Explorer

Machine-readable multi-league custom BPM data.

## Preferred endpoints

- Full documented JSON dataset: https://basketball-bpm-rebuilt.vercel.app/api/players.json
- Streaming NDJSON records: https://basketball-bpm-rebuilt.vercel.app/api/players.ndjson
- CSV records: https://basketball-bpm-rebuilt.vercel.app/api/players.csv
- NBA-only JSON: https://basketball-bpm-rebuilt.vercel.app/api/nba/players.json
- EuroLeague-only JSON: https://basketball-bpm-rebuilt.vercel.app/api/euroleague/players.json

## Identity rules

Use player_key to track a player within a source across seasons, teams, and leagues. Official nbl1 UUIDs and Proballers or Sports Reference IDs belong to different namespaces and are not automatically linked. Use record_id to identify one calculated league/player/season result. Never join records across sources by display name alone.

## Important interpretation

bpm is the final custom BPM, raw is the season-level box-score component, and adj is the team adjustment. Multi-team seasons are calculated by stint and combined using minutes. Real players with no recorded minutes have null BPM. This is not official Basketball-Reference BPM 2.0; see methodology.json and quality.json before reproducing or interpreting calculations.
